Field.Label: Water Leak Monitor — settings are read from IndigoSecrets.py first (where applicable). The fields below are a fallback for users without IndigoSecrets.py.
Leak Sensor Device ID:
Field.Description: Right-click the sensor, choose Copy ID and paste it here. Blank watches nothing.

Field.Label: Fallback recipient for leak-alert emails. Used only if WATERLEAK_ALERT_EMAIL is missing from IndigoSecrets.py.
Re-alert every (minutes):
Field.Description: Re-send the alert this often while the sensor stays wet. 0 = alert once only.

Field.Label: Emergency makes Pushover repeat the leak alert every 10 minutes, for up to 24 hours, until you tap Acknowledge in the Pushover app. High sends it once, and both get through Pushover's quiet hours.
Pushover leak sound:
Field.Description: A Pushover sound name, such as siren, persistent or echo.

Field.Label: If Indigo's Last Changed time for the sensor is older than this, the sensor counts as not answering and you are told. A flat battery usually looks like this: the sensor just stops reporting.
Battery state name:
Field.Description: Blank = do not check the battery.

Field.Label: The name of the sensor's battery state in Indigo (look at the sensor's states in Indigo's main window). If the sensor has no state of this name, the battery is simply not checked.
